come what may phrase

also whatever happens, we’ll take what comes, take it philosophically, whatever comes

classical

Ter. Ph. 138
Traupman 294

Quod fors feret, ferēmus aequō animō.

come what may, we’ll take it calmly

Fors, chance, what luck brings: literally “what chance brings, we shall bear with a level mind”. Cicero has the like ut fors tulerit, as luck will have it (Att., Lewis & Short s.v. fors).

Examples

  • Ūnum hoc sciō: quod fors feret, ferēmus aequō animō.

    I know this one thing: whatever luck brings, we’ll bear it calmly.Ter. Ph. 1.2.88 (Lewis & Short s.v. fors)

See also chance, calmly.
